title: PACCAR Incorporated: Instrument Panel Display Failure/FMVSS 101 & 121 (18,332 affected)
summary: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Kenworth T680, T880, and W990 trucks. The 15-inch digital display may fail to display warning lights or vehicle speed. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 101, "Controls and Displays" and 121, "Air Brake Systems."

title: Mazda North American Operations: Inaccurate Fuel Gauge Reading (104,854 affected)
summary: Mazda North American Operations (Mazda) is recalling certain 2024-2025 CX-90 and 2025 CX-70 mild hybrid electric vehicles (MHEV). The fuel gauge in the instrument cluster may display an inaccurate fuel reading.

title: Orange EV: Driveshaft May Contact and Damage Brake Chamber (16 affected)
summary: Orange EV (OEV) is recalling certain 2024-2025 HUSK-e Tandem terminal trucks. The driveshaft may contact and damage the passenger side brake chamber or brake chamber bracket.

title: Ducati North America: Rear Wheel Axle Failure (10,235 affected)
summary: Ducati North America (Ducati) is recalling certain 2020-2021 Panigale V4 SL, 2019-2024 Panigale V4 R, 2018-2024 Panigale V4 S, 2023-2025 Streetfighter, 2018-2024 Panigale V4, and 2020-2022 Streetfighter V4 motorcycles.  The rear wheel axle could lose its structural integrity and break.

title: Magna International Inc.: Blank or Inverted Rearview Camera Image (250,292 affected)
summary: Magna International Inc. (Magna) is recalling certain rearview cameras installed on certain Ford and Chrysler vehicles. Please see the recall report for a complete list of part numbers. The rearview camera may display a blank or inverted image.

title: International Motors, LLC: Missing Underfloor Reinforcement/FMVSS 210, 222 (457 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2016-2026 IC Bus CESB and 2016-2021 RESB school buses. The underfloor reinforcement may not have been installed, compromising the structural integrity of the buses. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages" and 222, "School Bus Passenger Seating and Crash Protection."

title: Cruiser RV: Axle May Not Provide Enough Clearance (10 affected)
summary: Cruiser RV (Cruiser) is recalling certain 2025 Avenir travel trailers. The underslung axle may not provide enough clearance, allowing the wheel wells to contact and damage the tires.

title: Jayco, Inc.: Incorrect GAWR on Label (75 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2026 Seismic fifth wheel travel trailers. The certification label lists an incorrect Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR). As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: TriMark Corporation: Defective Latch may Prevent Door from Opening (1,080 affected)
summary: TriMark Corporation (TriMark) is recalling certain door latches, part numbers 19233-01 (0534-EE3-001) and 19232-01 (0557-EE3-001), installed on Spartan Fire vehicles. The actuator lever arm in the cab door latch may bind or become wedged, preventing the door from opening.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Inoperative Defrosting and Defogging System (94,320 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2023-2025 bZ4X, Lexus RZ, and Subaru Solterra vehicles. During certain HVAC system faults, such as electrical compressor failure, the defroster and defogger system may become inoperative.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Loss of Drive Power (91,787 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Jeep Grand Cherokee Plug-In Hybrid Electric (PHEV) vehicles. A software error within the hybrid control processor may result in a loss of drive power.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Incorrect Cross Car Beam/FMVSS 208 (8 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2025 Jeep Wagoneer S vehicles. The vehicles are equipped with an incorrect cross car beam in the instrument panel. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Vehicle Rollaway Risk/FMVSS 114 (75 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Dodge Charger and Jeep Wagoneer S electric vehicles. An incorrectly installed spring may cause the loss of the park function when the vehicle’s gear selector is placed in the park (P) position, which can result in a vehicle rollaway. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 114, "Theft Protection and Rollaway Prevention."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Improperly Sealed Side Curtain Air Bags/FMVSS 226 (985 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2025 Pacifica and Voyager vehicles. The right and left side curtain air bags may have insufficient pressure retention from improperly sealed seams. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 226, "Ejection Mitigation."

title: Ford Motor Company: Blank or Distorted Rearview Camera Image (1,456,417 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2015-2019 Lincoln MKC, Mustang, F-350 SD, F-250 SD, F-450 SD, 2015-2017 Lincoln Navigator, Expedition, 2015-2018 Edge, Transit Connect, 2016-2019 F-550 SD, Transit, 2017-2019 Econoline, and 2019 Ranger vehicles. The rearview camera may display a distorted, inverted, or blank image when the vehicle is in reverse.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Left Handlebar Switch May Corrode (7,492 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2020-2022 and 2024-2025 CRF1100 Africa Twin motorcycles. The left handlebar switch harness may corrode due to oxidation, resulting in the loss of horn function or the ability to switch the headlight from low beam to high beam. As such, these motorcycles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Loss of Power Steering Assist (17,330 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2025 Acura RDX vehicles. The software for the electric power steering (EPS) assist may not be calibrated properly, which can cause the EPS system to enter a failsafe mode, resulting in a loss of power steering assist.

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Blown Fuse May Cause Engine Shutdown (19 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Altec Aerial Device, and Digger Derrick vehicles. The chassis ignition circuit may be overloaded, which can result in a blown fuse and cause an engine shutdown.

title: Spartan Fire, LLC: Defective Latch may Prevent Door from Opening (1,261 affected)
summary: Spartan Fire, LLC (Spartan) is recalling certain 2023-2026 Gladiator, Metrostar, FC-94, KME Panther, and 2024-2025 Predator vehicles. The actuator lever arm in the cab door latch may bind or become wedged, preventing the door from opening.

title: Rivian Automotive, LLC: Hands-Free Highway Assist Software May Incorrectly Identify Other Vehicles (24,214 affected)
summary: Rivian Automotive, LLC (Rivian) is recalling certain 2025 R1S and R1T vehicles operating a software version prior to 2025.18.30. The Hands-Free Highway Assist (HWA) software may fail to correctly identify a lead vehicle.

title: Storyteller Overland: Improperly Routed Wires in Auxiliary Power System (61 affected)
summary: Storyteller Overland, LLC (Storyteller) is recalling certain 2024-2026 GXV Hilt recreational vehicles. The auxiliary power system wires may have been improperly. The wires may be damaged by contact with the intake manifold.

title: Zero Motorcycles Inc.: Loss of Drive Power (319 affected)
summary: Zero Motorcycles Inc. (Zero) is recalling certain 2023-2024 DSR/X, 2024 DS, DSR, and DSRP motorcycles. Improperly routed key switch signal wires may break, causing a loss of drive power.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Loss of Drive Power (53,849 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2017-2019 Alfa Romeo Giulia and 2018-2019 Alfa Romeo Stelvio vehicles. The fuel pump may fail, which can result in a loss of fuel flow and loss of drive power.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: Upper Triple Clamp May Fracture (8,424 affected)
summary: Harley-Davidson Motor Company (Harley-Davidson) is recalling certain RH1250S (Sportster S) motorcycles. The upper triple clamp may fracture.

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: Damaged Seat Belt Retractor (1,357 affected)
summary: Volvo Car USA, LLC (Volvo Car) is recalling certain 2026 Volvo XC90MHEV, XC60MHEV, V90CCMHEV, and V60CCMHEV vehicles. The torsion bar in the front seat belt retractors may have been damaged during production.

title: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc.: Service Door May Disengage from Opening Mechanism (2,454 affected)
summary: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2023-2025 T- Series, G5, and 2024-2025 MBII school buses equipped with a power-assisted service door. The rod-eye rings attaching the front and rear door panels to the opening gear may delaminate, preventing the door from being controlled by the driver.

title: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc.: Service Door May Disengage from Opening Mechanism (419 affected)
summary: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2023-2025 G5 transit buses equipped with a power-assisted service door. The rod-eye rings attaching the front and rear door panels to the opening gear may delaminate, preventing the door from being controlled by the driver.

title: KTM North America, Inc.: Throttle Failure (9,070 affected)
summary: KTM North America, Inc. is recalling certain 2022-2023 Husqvarna Svartpilen 401, Husqvarna Vitpilen 401, and 2022-2024 KTM 390 Adventure motorcycles. Water could enter the throttle (e-throttle) control unit and cause it to fail, resulting in loss of drive power.

title: Ford Motor Company: High Pressure Fuel Pump May Leak and Cause a Fire (9 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024 Bronco and Ranger vehicles. The bolts securing the high pressure fuel pump may not be tightened properly, which can result in a fuel leak.

title: Villa International: Incorrect Weld May Cause Seat Failure/FMVSS 207, 210 (16 affected)
summary: Villa International is recalling certain pedestals and seat anchorages, part number 400004. The pedestal mounting plate may be improperly welded, causing the plate to separate and the seat assembly to loosen or detach. As such, these seat assemblies fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 207, "Seating Systems," and 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages."

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Instrument Panel Failure (591,377 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Toyota Venza, 2023-2025 RAV4 Prime, RAV4, Highlander, GR Corolla, Crown, 2024-2025 Lexus TX, LS, Toyota Tacoma, Grand Highlander, and 2025 Lexus RX, Toyota Crown Signia, Camry, RAV 4 Plug-in Hybrid (PHEV), and 4 Runner vehicles. Due to an error in the instrument panel software at vehicle startup, the instrument panel may fail to display vehicle speed, brake system, and tire pressure warning lights.

title: General Motors, LLC: Electronic Stability Control Light May Not Illuminate/FMVSS 126 (1,191 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2026 Chevrolet Silverado EV and GMC Sierra EV electric vehicles.  After experiencing an electronic stability control (ESC) system malfunction, the ESC malfunction warning light may not illuminate on the next key cycle.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 126, "Electronic Stability Control Systems."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Driver and Passenger Door Trim Pieces May Detach (163,735 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain  2022-2025 Jeep Wagoneer and Jeep Grand Wagoneer vehicles. The trim on the driver and passenger doors may not have been installed properly, which can allow it to detach.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Side Curtain Air Bag Inflators May Rupture (1,761 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2018 Ram 1500, Ram 2500, and Ram 3500 vehicles. The right and left side curtain air bag inflators may rupture due to a manufacturing defect.

title: Aprilia USA, Inc.: Rear Turn Signals and Tail Lights May Flicker (720 affected)
summary: Aprilia USA, Inc. (Aprilia) is recalling certain 2026 RSV4 1100 E5+ Factory, RSV4 1100 E5+, Tuono 1100 E5+ F, Tuono 1100 E5+ sports motorcycles. The turn signals and tail lights may flicker or stop working.

title: Ford Motor Company: Seat Belt Anchor Pretensioner Cables May Corrode and Break (332,778 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2015-2017 Mustang vehicles. Water and road salt may corrode the front seat belt anchor pretensioner cables.

title: Yamaha Motor Corporation, USA: Ladder Welds May Fail (922 affected)
summary: Yamaha Motor Corporation, USA (Yamaha) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Skeeter FXR boat trailers. The boarding ladder used to gain access to the bow of the boat was manufactured with incomplete welds that can cause the ladder to fail.

title: Orange EV: Hazard Lights May Shut Off/FMVSS 108 (1,378 affected)
summary: Orange EV (OEV) is recalling certain 2017-2024 T-Series, 2023-2025 e-TRIEVER, and HUSK-e terminal trucks. The hazard warning lights may turn off when the ignition is in the 'Off' position. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Ford Motor Company: Driver and Front Passenger Door Trim May Detach (101,944 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2016-2019 Taurus vehicles. The driver and front passenger B-Pillar door trim may detach while driving.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Inconsistently Stripped Wires May Cause Electrical Arcing (502 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Spirit and Shasta Oasis recreational trailers. The 30 AMP or 50 AMP inlet wire sheathing may be inconsistently stripped, causing electrical arcing.

title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Improperly Reinforced Frame Members (4 affected)
summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2024 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 2500 and Sprinter 3500 vehicles. The longitudinal frame members may not be reinforced properly.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Charging Port Door Panel May Detach (31,042 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2023-2025 IONIQ 6 electric vehicles. The charging port door panel may detach.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Seat Belt Buckles May Fail (568,580 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2020-2025 Palisade vehicles. The seat belt buckles in the driver, passenger, and second-row window seats may fail to latch.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Loss of Vehicle Stability Control from Improperly Tightened Fasteners (8 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2025 IONIQ 5 electric vehicles. Certain rear suspension alignment adjustment bolts may have been improperly tightened, which can cause a loss of vehicle stability control.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Loss of Steering Control from Improperly Installed Fasteners (99 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain Thomas Built Buses 2025-2026 Saf-T-Liner HDX, Saf-T-Liner C2, 2026 Saf-T-Liner EFX, and Saf-T-Liner C2 Jouley school buses. The tie rod castle nut and cotter pin may not be installed properly, which can result in a loss of vehicle steering control.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Loss of Steering Control from Improperly Installed Fasteners (343 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Western Star 47X, Freightliner Business Class M2, FCCC MT55G, 2025-2026 Western Star 49X, Freightliner Cascadia, Freightliner 114SD, FCCC MT45G, FCCC S2RV106, 2026 Thomas Built Buses Saf-T-Liner C2, Freightliner eCascadia, FCCC S2C106, and Freightliner 108SD vehicles. The tie rod castle nut and cotter pin may not be installed properly, which can result in a loss of vehicle steering control.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Loose Brake Caliper Mounting Bolts (36 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain Thomas Built Buses 2025-2026 Saf-T-Liner C2 and Saf-T-Liner C2 Jouley school buses. The brake caliper mounting bolts may loosen and detach, which can cause a loss of brake function and damage the tire and/or wheel.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Loose Brake Caliper Mounting Bolts (402 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2025 FCCC XCR, FCCC XBS, FCCC MT45, Western Star 57X, 2025-2026 Freightliner Business Class M2, Freightliner Cascadia, Freightliner 114SD, Freightliner 108SD, FCCC MT55G, FCCC MT45G, FCCC XCP, FCCC XCM, Western Star 49X, Western Star 47X, 2026 Freightliner Cascadia 5th Gen, FCCC MT55, and FCCC MT50E vehicles. The brake caliper mounting bolts may loosen and detach, which can cause a loss of brake function and damage the tire and/or wheel.

title: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc.: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display (27,816 affected)
summary: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc. (Polestar) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Polestar 2 vehicles. The rearview camera image may not display when the vehicle is placed in reverse.

title: Autoliv, Inc.: Damaged Seat Belt Retractor (3,968 affected)
summary: Autoliv, Inc. (Autoliv) is recalling certain Seat Belt Assemblies, part number R230.2LLA. The torsion bar in the seat belt retractor may have been damaged during production.

title: ZF North America, Inc.: Loss of Drive Power or Park Function (2,312 affected)
summary: ZF North America, Inc. (ZF) submitted a defect information report based upon the recall determinations made by BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) and Chrysler (FCA US, LLC). An insufficient weld in the transmission control unit can allow transmission fluid to leak on to electrical components, resulting in a loss of drive power or park function.

title: Reading Truck Group LLC: Trailer Hitch May Detach (10 affected)
summary: Reading Truck Body, LLC (Reading) is recalling certain 2023 Ram 4500 vehicles equipped with a Curt Hitch (P/N 15400). The trailer hitch may have been installed with too few mounting bolts, causing the assembly to loosen and detach.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Damaged Seat Belt Retractor (1,571 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC is recalling certain 2025-2026 X1 and X2, MINI Cooper Convertible, MINI Cooper, Mini Countryman S ALL4, and 2025 MINI Countryman SE ALL4 vehicles. The torsion bar in both front seat belt retractors may have been damaged during production.

title: Ford Motor Company: Incorrect Tires and Steering Coupler Cover Installed (212 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Transit vehicles repaired incorrectly under recall numbers 24V226 and 24V591. An incorrect steering coupler cover and tires that were not designed for the vehicle may have been installed during a previous repair.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: Inoperative Trailer Lighting (156 affected)
summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Pioneer vehicles. When towing a trailer, the trailer lights may fail to illuminate due to an improperly manufactured body control module.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: Inoperative Trailer Lighting (2,307 affected)
summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2025-2026 New VN trucks. When towing a trailer, the trailer lights may fail to illuminate due to an improperly manufactured body control module.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: Defective Latch May Prevent Door from Opening (3,609 affected)
summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2026 New VN trucks. The door latch cable on the interior door handle may be incorrectly installed, preventing the door from opening.

title: General Motors, LLC: Replacement Fuel Tank May Leak During a Rollover Crash (12 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2021 Cadillac Escalade, 2021, 2023-2024 Chevrolet Tahoe, and 2022 and 2024 GMC Yukon vehicles equipped with a 6-cylinder diesel engine. The original fuel tank may have been replaced with an incorrect fuel tank, which can allow fuel to leak in a rollover crash.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: Fuel Heater May Overheat and Cause a Fire (11,385 affected)
summary: Isuzu Motors Limited (Isuzu) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Isuzu FVR, Isuzu FTR, Chevrolet 6500XD, and 2023-2026 Chevrolet 7500XD vehicles. The fuel heater may overheat, melting the casing and allowing fuel to leak into the electrical connector.

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Incorrect GAWR on Certification Label (135 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Aerial Device, 2022-2024 Forestry Body, 2022-2025 Service Body, and 2025 Digger Derrick vehicles. The Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR) listed on the vehicle certification label may be incorrect, leading to the vehicle being unintentionally overloaded.

title: Ford Motor Company: Engine Compartment Fire (4,632 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020 Expedition and Lincoln Navigator vehicles. A short circuit within the battery junction box can cause an engine fire while driving or parked.

title: Brenner Tank, LLC: Internal and Outlet Valve May Corrode and Leak (8 affected)
summary: Brenner Tank, LLC (Brenner Tank) is recalling certain 2025-2026 TKQXFR tank trailers. The internal and outlet valves may corrode and leak.

title: Ford Motor Company: Loss of Steering Control from Steering Column Detachment (115,539 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2021 F-250, F-350, and F-450 vehicles. The steering column upper shaft may detach from the steering column and result in a loss of steering control.

title: Wabash National Corporation: Insufficient Rear Impact Protection/FMVSS 224 (10 affected)
summary: Wabash National Corporation (Wabash) is recalling certain 2026 DVCVHPC van trailers. The incorrect rear impact guard may have been installed. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 224, "Rear Impact Protection."

title: Hyundai Motor America: Windshield Molding May Detach (7,855 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Genesis GV60 electric vehicles. The stainless-steel molding at the top of the windshield assembly may detach.

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: High Voltage Battery System May Short Circuit (12 affected)
summary: Motor Coach Industries (MCI) is recalling certain 2024 D45CRTE, D45CRTELE, and 2025 J4500E coaches. The high voltage battery may experience a short circuit within the battery module when charging to near or full capacity.

title: New Flyer of America, Inc.: High Voltage Battery System May Short Circuit (655 affected)
summary: New Flyer of America, Inc. (New Flyer) is recalling certain 2019 XE35, 2021-2025 XE35, XE40, and XE60 transit buses. The high voltage battery may experience a short circuit within the battery module when charging to near or full capacity.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Engine Starter May Corrode and Overheat (199,674 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2019-2021 BMW 330i, 2019-2022 BMW Z4, 2020-2022 BMW 530i, X3, X4, Toyota Supra, 2021-2022 BMW 430i, 430i Convertible, and 2022 BMW 230i vehicles. The engine starter relay may corrode, causing the relay to overheat and short circuit.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: Parking Brake May Unintentionally Engage (150 affected)
summary: Blue Bird Bus Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2021-2026 Vision school buses. The brake interlock software may unintentionally activate the parking brake at any driving speed.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: High Pressure Fuel Pump May Leak and Cause a Fire (177 affected)
summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Panamera, Cayenne, and 2025 Panamera E-Hybrid vehicles. The fasteners securing the high pressure fuel pump may not be tightened properly, resulting in a fuel leak.

title: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini): High Pressure Fuel Pump May Leak and Cause a Fire (14 affected)
summary: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini) is recalling certain 2025 Urus vehicles. The fasteners securing the high pressure fuel pump may not be tightened properly, resulting in a fuel leak.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Damaged Seat Belt Retractor (1,042 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2025 GTI, Golf R, Audi A5, A6 Sportback E-Tron, S5, S6 Sportback E-Tron, 2026 Q4 Sportback E-Tron, and Q4 E-Tron vehicles. The torsion bar in one or both front seat belt retractors may have been damaged during production.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: High Pressure Fuel Pump May Leak and Cause a Fire (1 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling one Audi SQ7 vehicles. The fasteners securing the high pressure fuel pump may not be tightened properly, resulting in a fuel leak.

title: Lippert: Paddle Latch May Unintentionally Lock Liquid Propane Compartment (815 affected)
summary: Lippert is recalling certain Paddle Latches with part number 2021097882, equipped on REV Recreation Group vehicles when used in the Liquid Propane (LP) compartment door. The paddle latch may unintentionally lock, preventing operators from accessing the LP compartment.

title: Cognito Motorsports: Ball Joint Disengaging from Upper Control Arm (12,160 affected)
summary: Cognito Motorsports (Cognito) is recalling certain Rev C Ball Joints with part number 91253, for installation on 2011-2025 GMC and Chevrolet 2500HD and 3500HD trucks. The ball stud may pull through the housing, causing the upper control arm to disengage.

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Platform Retaining Plate Bolts may be Improperly Tightened (77 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2024-2025 A Class vehicles. The platform retaining plate bolts might not have been properly tightened during assembly.

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Exhaust May Overheat Outrigger Pad (268 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2021-2025 AA Series, 2024-2025 AM Series, and 2025 AN Series aerial devices. The outrigger pad holder may have been installed too close to the exhaust outlet.

title: Kia America, Inc.: Fire from HVAC Wiring Harness (39,536 affected)
summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Sorento vehicles. The heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) blower motor wiring harness may be inadequate, which can result in a fire.

title: Evenflo Company, Inc.: Choking Hazard from Foam in Child Seat Headrest (324,997 affected)
summary: Evenflo Company, Inc. (Evenflo) is recalling certain Gold Revolve360 Slim and Revolve360 Slim child seats manufactured between December 1, 2022 and December 8, 2024.  Please refer to Evenflo's recall report for specific model and color information. The headrest foam is not adequately secured away from the child, which can allow the child to pick off pieces of foam.

title: Bentley Motors, Inc.: High Pressure Fuel Pump May Leak and Cause a Fire (17 affected)
summary: Bentley Motors, Inc. (Bentley) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Continental GTC, Continental GT, and 2025 Flying Spur vehicles. The bolted joint connection securing the high-pressure fuel pump to the V8 Evo engine may be improperly tightened and cause a fuel leak.

title: International Motors, LLC: Parking Brake May Unintentionally Activate (14 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2025-2026 IC Bus CECB commercial buses. A tire may contact and damage the air dryer discharge line, causing an air leak and the unintentional activation of the parking brake.

title: International Motors, LLC: Parking Brake May Unintentionally Activate (11,952 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2024-2026 IC Bus CESB school buses. A tire may contact and damage the air dryer discharge line, causing an air leak and the unintentional activation of the parking brake.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display (3,818 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2023 Range Rover Evoque vehicles. Water may enter the rearview camera, which can cause the rearview camera image not to appear on the display or display a distorted image.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Starter Motor May Fail and Overheat (145,102 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2020 340I, X6, 2020-2025 840I, 2020-2022 740LI, 2019-2020 X7, and X5 vehicles. After repeated attempts, the starter motor may overheat from an electrical overload.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Improperly Connected Battery Cables (4 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2026 M4 and 430i vehicles. The positive battery cables may not be properly connected to the power distribution box, resulting in an engine stall and a fire.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Driver and Passenger Window Trim Pieces May Detach (7,738 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain Mopar rear quarter glass window assemblies. Please refer to FCA US, LLC's recall report for specific model numbers. The quarter trim on the driver and passenger windows may not have been properly secured, which can allow it to detach.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Driver and Passenger Window Trim Pieces May Detach (123,396 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Jeep Wagoneer and Jeep Grand Wagoneer vehicles. The quarter trim on the driver and passenger windows may not have been properly secured, which can allow it to detach.

title: International Motors, LLC: Windshield Wipers May Fail (3 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2026 IC Bus CECB commercial buses. The weld on the crank shaft assembly may fail, preventing the  the left-side wiper from working.

title: International Motors, LLC: Windshield Wipers May Fail (4,778 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2026 IC Bus CESB school buses. The weld on the crank shaft assembly may fail, preventing the  the left-side wiper from working.

title: General Motors, LLC: Insufficient Pedestrian Warning Sound/FMVSS 141 (23,700 affected)
summary: General Motors LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2024 Chevrolet Equinox EV vehicles. The pedestrian alert sound system may not produce a sufficient change in volume between the vehicle being stopped and moving at low speeds.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 141, "Minimum Sound Requirements for Hybrid and Electric Vehicles."

title: MEDIX SPECIALTY VEHICLES, INC.: Quick Liner Wheel Covers May Detach and Become a Road Hazard (396 affected)
summary: Medix Specialty Vehicles, Inc. (Medix) is recalling certain Phoenix Quick Liner Wheel Covers installed, with the clip-on feature, on Medix Ford Type-III ambulances. The wheel covers may detach during transit.

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: Power Operated Tailgate May Drop Suddenly (1,119 affected)
summary: Volvo Car USA, LLC (Volvo) is recalling certain 2025 EX90 vehicles. A spindle nut may detach from the Power Operated Tailgate (POT) drive units, causing the tailgate to suddenly drop.

title: Thor Motor Coach: LP Tank May Detach and Become a Road Hazard (23 affected)
summary: Thor Motor Coach (TMC) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Luminate and Indigo recreational vehicles. The LP tank support tube may be too short and have an insufficient weld that may fracture, allowing the tank to detach.

title: Q'Straint: Wheelchair Restraint Retractor May Not Lock (6,200 affected)
summary: Q'Straint is recalling certain QRT-Deluxe and QRT-Max wheelchair restraints. The retractors may not lock, preventing the wheelchair from being properly secured.
